entities.name: FtsH ATP-dependent protease
observations: 652-aa query has 62.3% identity and 92.8% coverage to reviewed Cupriavidus metallidurans FtsH (UniProt Q1LLA9).
Homology supports a membrane-anchored, ATP-dependent zinc metalloprotease involved in cytoplasmic and membrane-protein quality control.
Reference FtsH annotations indicate two N-terminal transmembrane helices, followed by a large cytosolic catalytic region.
Reviewed homolog evidence indicates Zn2+ binding and homohexameric assembly.
